full_prompt_en: A square painterly historical illustration shows a steam locomotive pushing into a crowded station beneath a towering column of dark smoke. The background contains a broad station canopy on the left and pale industrial structures receding through haze on the right. Warm orange light glows under the canopy and behind the train, contrasting with the dirty gray atmosphere. Near the center, the green locomotive advances toward the viewer on a diagonal track, its round dark front mounted above a vivid red buffer beam. Thick black smoke rises from its chimney and spreads into a heavy cloud across the upper half of the image. White steam escapes around the wheels and along the lower body, partly veiling the rails. A red carriage trails away into the bright left background. Another muted green engine appears farther right, partly obscured by drifting vapor and people. Crowds in dark coats and hats line both sides of the track; the closest figures form uneven clusters along the lower left and lower right. One person near the lower middle walks away from the viewer toward the engine, establishing the scale of the machine and the depth of the platform. The rails and wet, pale paving converge behind the locomotive, carrying the eye into the crowded distance. Brushwork is broad and broken in smoke and masonry, while sharper dark marks pick out the engine's circular face, carriage edges, hats, and rail lines. The illumination is smoky and diffuse, but the amber glow catches the metal and steam from behind, giving the machine a dark front against a lit atmosphere. The overall composition is energetic and densely inhabited, joining cool green-gray massing with fiery warm light and restless painted texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式历史题材插画呈现一列蒸汽机车在高耸深烟之下驶入拥挤的车站。后景左侧有宽阔的站台顶棚，右侧浅色工业建筑在雾气中逐渐后退。暖橙色光从顶棚下及列车后方透出，与脏灰色空气形成对比。中央附近，绿色机车沿斜向轨道朝观者驶来，圆形深色车头装在鲜红色缓冲梁上方。浓黑烟从烟囱升起，扩散成压住画面上半部的厚重云团。白色蒸汽从车轮周围和车体下缘逸出，部分遮住铁轨。一节红色车厢拖向明亮的左侧远景。右边还有另一台低饱和绿色机车，部分被飘散的水汽与人群遮挡。穿深色外套、戴帽的人群排列在轨道两侧；最近的人物在左下和右下形成不规则的团簇。下部中央附近有一人背对观者走向机车，衬托机器的尺度与站台的纵深。铁轨与湿润浅色铺地在机车后方汇聚，把视线引入拥挤的远处。烟雾和建筑由宽阔而破碎的笔触绘成，较锐利的深色笔痕则点出车头圆面、车厢边缘、帽子和轨道线。光线在烟中漫散，但后方琥珀色光照到金属和蒸汽，使机器的深色正面衬在发亮空气前。整体构图充满能量与人群密度，以冷调绿灰大形结合炽暖亮光与不安定的绘画肌理。
style_prompt_en: The painterly illustration builds a large mechanical or structural presence from broad green-gray masses, then sets it against amber light and thick blue-black atmospheric movement. Broken opaque brushstrokes keep smoke, masonry, and paving restless, while a few precise dark curves and straight lines preserve recognizable structure. Crowded small forms collect along converging diagonals, generating scale and motion without equal detail everywhere. Bright pale vapor passes across lower dark areas, briefly hiding hard edges and then revealing them again. Highlights emerge through haze rather than sitting as clean white gloss. The palette moves from soot gray and desaturated green through warm rust, red, and orange, with the strongest chromatic heat concentrated toward the backlit region. Perspective lines and clustered marks draw attention to a central near mass, while deeper space dissolves into atmospheric paint. The overall effect is bustling, weighty, and dramatic, with the texture of weather and motion inseparable from the forms.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画式插画先以宽阔绿灰色块建立巨大的机械或构造体量，再用琥珀色光与浓重蓝黑色气流与之对照。破碎的不透明笔触让烟、墙体和铺地持续躁动，少数精确的深色弧线与直线则保持结构可辨。密集的小形体沿汇聚斜线聚集，建立尺度与运动感，却不让每处细节等量铺开。明亮浅色水汽穿过下部暗区，暂时遮住硬边后又让它们显露。高光从雾中浮现，而非作为洁白光泽贴在表面。配色从煤灰与低饱和绿走向暖锈色、红和橙，最强的暖色集中在逆光区域。透视线与成簇笔痕把注意力引向近处中央大形，更深的空间则溶入大气笔触。整体效果繁忙、厚重且富于戏剧性，天气与运动的肌理同形体不可分开。
theme_en: A steam locomotive arriving through smoke and crowded station platforms
theme_zh: 蒸汽机车穿过烟雾驶入拥挤的车站站台
name: Terence Cuneo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
